description: Search normalized public business-register / new-filing records. PROMOTED (2026-10-16): ct_business_registry (Connecticut Business Master, 1.30M entities), or_business_registry (Oregon active businesses, 1.58M), pa_business_registry (Pennsylvania registered businesses, 4.17M), tx_franchise_taxpayers (Texas franchise-tax accounts incl. SOS file numbers, 3.49M) — all via the states' official Socrata open-data portals with exact counts. GATED: co_business_entities (Colorado SOS automated-collection authorization + written terms) and ny_business_filings (NY Open Data written consent) return the named gate; Arizona stays planned (Business Center is CAPTCHA/identity-gated, no public API). fedwatch_sources carries a businesses entry for all 50 states + DC. Filters a source cannot honor exactly (e.g. entity_type on CT, which publishes none) are refused with the reason.

county.description: PA: county name; NY (gated): county of principal office

entity_type.description: Entity type filter (OR exact, PA/TX fragment; refused for CT)

filing_type.description: NY only (gated): exact filing type, e.g. 'ARTICLES OF ORGANIZATION'

formed_after.description: ISO date — only entities formed/registered after it (the new-business window)

source_id.description: Source id: ct_business_registry (default), or_business_registry, pa_business_registry, tx_franchise_taxpayers, co_business_entities / ny_business_filings (gated)

status.description: Exact entity status where the source publishes one (CT/OR; CO gated)

name: businesses_search
